help.stock_available: Units on the shelf and free to sell. Reserved, damaged and incoming are tracked in their own columns.
help.stock_reserved: Set aside for orders that are placed but not shipped yet.
help.stock_damaged: Written off as unsellable, and not part of the available count.
help.stock_incoming: Booked against purchase orders that have been sent to the supplier but not received yet.
help.low_stock_threshold: Once available stock drops to this number the product is flagged as low stock on the dashboard.
help.avg_order_value: Revenue divided by the number of orders paid in this period. Revenue is money received: an order counts the day it is paid, a refund subtracts the day it is given back.
help.discounts_given: Everything taken off orders paid in this period: coupons plus discounts keyed in by hand at the register.
help.est_profit: Revenue in this period minus what the items paid for cost to buy. A refund takes back both the money and the cost. Goods given away (an order that came to 0) count on the day the order is completed. Shipping and overheads are not deducted.
help.written_off: What the stock damaged, lost or decreased by hand in this period cost to buy, plus the net of count corrections (shortages minus units found). Goods sent back to a supplier are shown apart and not counted as a loss. Not included in the estimated profit, which covers goods sold.
help.inventory_cost_value: What the stock you still own cost to buy, at the price each delivery was bought for: units on the shelf plus units held for orders not paid yet. Once an order is paid its goods count as sold.
help.inventory_retail_value: What that same stock would bring in at current selling prices.
help.outstanding: What completing the order would still collect: the total minus payments, net of refunds. Nothing for cancelled or refunded orders.
